verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own AI-powered applicant scoring, which gives each applicant a 0–100 score so recruiters can review the strongest candidates first. That covers the core AI screening and matching. The pack contains no documentation of how the scoring works or what safeguards apply to automated decisions; the EEO survey is a separate, adjacent feature and earns no credit. missing for 10: explanation of the scoring methodology and criteria, documented safeguards for automated decisions (human-in-the-loop review, bias auditing, candidate transparency or appeal), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, AI helps screen and match candidates against the role — with the vendor documenting how it works and what safeguards apply to automated decisions

citations.quote: Each applicant gets a score from 0 to 100, so you can review your strongest candidates first.
